name: A Date With Denial
source:
You wake up and find yourself on a romantic dinner date with a mysterious man, who introduces himself as Zecharias. You have no memory of ever meeting this man, or agreeing to go on a date with him.

You have to figure out what's going on before it's too late.

[from [url=https://batter-sempai.itch.io/a-date-with-denial]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒來，發現自己正與一個神秘男人共進浪漫晚餐。他自稱澤卡里亞斯，可你完全不記得曾見過他，更不記得答應過與他約會。

你必須在一切太遲之前，弄清究竟發生了什麼。

[摘自[url=https://batter-sempai.itch.io/a-date-with-denial]itch.io[/url]]
